english.note: Use this when someone is not putting their mind or care into a responsibility, rather than simply being forgetful.
Use this when the person is apathetic or unconcerned about something, rather than physically sluggish.

examples.english: You’re being neglectful about your homework, so how can you get good marks?
examples.traditional: 你對份功課咁唔上心，點會有好成績？
examples.jyutping: nei5 deoi3 fan6 gung1 fo3 gam3 m4 soeng5 sam1 dim2 wui5 jau5 hou2 sing4 zik1

examples.english: They are lethargic about their new job and do everything half-heartedly.
examples.traditional: 佢對份新工好唔上心，叫佢做乜都得過且過。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 fan2 san1 gung1 hou2 m4 soeng5 sam1 giu3 keoi5 zou6 mat1 dou1 dak1 gwo3 ce2 gwo3
